title: 1992 AMC 8 Problem 7
statement: The digit-sum of \(998\) is \(9 + 9 + 8 = 26.\) How many \(3\)-digit whole numbers, whose digit-sum is \(26\), are even?

solutions.text:
A digit-sum of \(26\) with three digits requires the digits \(9,\) \(9,\) and \(8.\) The \(3\)-digit numbers using them are \(899,\) \(989,\) and \(998.\)

Of these, only \(998\) is even, so there is exactly \(1\) such number.

Thus, the correct answer is A .
hints: A digit-sum of \(26\) forces the three digits to be very large
The only digits that work are \(9,\) \(9,\) and \(8\); list the arrangements and keep the even ones
